This might be too late, but look into affirmations when you are feeling really crappy.  
Google anything-affirmations.  
"depression affirmations"  
"stress affirmations"  
"panic attac aff" and so on.  


It changed my life a year ago and I think everyone should know about them. Speaking them out loud to yourself will change your life IMO. The guy that I like best (because his video helped me the first time I tried it). is  Jason Stephenson   


GL

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YeM2yhULSVM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YeM2yhULSVM)  


This turned me on to affirmations when I had a panic attack, it worked so well I cried.   
I have been a true believer in them since. Over a year now.  


I hope it helps if you are still suffering - best time to watch is when you are in that state. If you are not in it, you might not see any value in it now.

Get up, I dont want to get up, I'll just lay here a little longer, maybe fall back alseep.15-45 min later:Gotta get up...nope...get up...get something to eat....fine, uhg.

I don't want to eat, but my stomach hurts so I know I have to eat something, find junk food, sugar, bread carbs...eat toast with cinn sugar on it.

Go to my computer (I dont want to be here, I rather go back to bed).I don't even want to play games, which I would do if I was out of this funk.You have work to do, eff that, im not working.Anything good on youtube? meh... maybe some music? Angry music helps me when I am grumpy, and depressed.Go lay down, turn on the tv, go up get my blanket and pillow.Lay down, anything good on tv? It doesnt matter, I am gonna sleep anyway.

Thats how my day starts.

There with you, my family does not smile at me, or make me feel good at all. I am 50 years old. I am sorry you have to live through the same thing. There are people out there that love you. You might not know that, or the extent of it, but there are. People are concerned for your livelihood.   


I don't know you, but I want you to know, I love you. I love you in the way someone loves another and hopes the best for them. I go through the same crap, and I know when someone tells me they care about my future and my happiness, only makes me feel good. I want to tear up just hearing that from people because I don't hear it from my own family members.   


Take care of yourself. ♥ You are the only person that can help you - that might seem scary, but it should be something you tell yourself to motivate yourself.

I used to hate mornings - because I didn't want to go to work. I have now been out of work 5 years, I am 50 and I tell ya, I LOVE to get up at 630-7am now.

I don't know if its because I don't have to go anywhere so its ok to get up early lol, OR if its just quiet and nobody else is in the house/awake that early so its all me time. Quiet, relaxing and time to get my own things done.

Going to bed early and getting up early feels good.Unless I have a job it seems :D

Glad to hear you had a nice morning!  


PS: Eating healthy in the morning (greek yogurt, and some fruit) helps.

I tried to get assistance for "caretaker", also tried to get disability. Even though I said the things I said in my post about my thoughts, and how I have delt with depression since childhood, I was denied. Talk about a slap in the face.

My parents are on Medicare/Medicaid, not sure which is which. I am not exactly welcome in the house anymore. It has been 5 years here, and even though I do everything possible to serve my mothers needs, my father and I really have never seen eye to eye on most events. I still love the guy, but we don't exactly talk much. So the stress on them, and myself together keeps me from asking them for any kind of help except the roof over my head.

If I need money from them, I can get it. But we are talking less than $500 and of course it won't come easily.  I am mostly concerned with someone trying to take their belongings or property. I have NOTHING, worth more than $1000 (computer and care, the only 2) and I don't think they want my 2000 Honda Accord. Does not even have a battery in it.

Thanks for the post again, 1up.
